verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an Admin API, CLI, and MCP server for managing flags, segments, and environments, but nothing describes a bulk operation such as bulk-editing, bulk-toggling, or bulk-deleting many flags or items at once. These general-purpose interfaces are building blocks a user would have to script over. Segment overrides and release pipelines are targeting and rollout features, not bulk item operations, so they earn no credit here.
